title: The Gypsy Tea Room nightclub: location and size
summary: After the Army he ran the one-story Riverside-corner nightclub, which held 1,800 people and could be partitioned for smaller dances.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
